title: AnomalyAuditRecord
description: Record published by diagnostic-service to Kafka topic `anomaly-audit`, keyed by `event_id`, for every event whose anomaly score exceeded the threshold (REQ-019, docs/CONTRACTS.md §1.3).

event_timestamp.description: The scored event's own `timestamp`, as received.

threshold.description: Threshold in force when the anomaly triggered.

reason.description: Payload field with the largest deviation, or `type` for a rare event type.
